# Duluth News Tribune

> Regional news source for Duluth, Minnesota and the Upper Midwest covering local, state, national and international news with comprehensive weather and sports coverage.

The Duluth News Tribune is a regional news outlet serving Duluth, Minnesota and surrounding areas including Wisconsin, the Iron Range, and North Shore communities. The site provides breaking news, weather forecasts, sports coverage including UMD Bulldogs hockey, and community-focused journalism.

## Key Topics

- Duluth, Minnesota
- Local news
- Minnesota news
- Regional coverage
- Breaking news
- Weather forecasts
- Sports news
- College hockey
- UMD Bulldogs
- Wisconsin news
- National news
- Community updates
- Prep sports
- Newspaper archives
- Obituaries

## News & Local Coverage

- [Duluth News](https://www.duluthnewstribune.com/news): Main news hub with Duluth, Minnesota and Wisconsin headlines
- [Local News](https://www.duluthnewstribune.com/news/local): Local news from Duluth, Superior, Hermantown and regional communities
- [Minnesota News](https://www.duluthnewstribune.com/news/minnesota): Minnesota state news including Iron Range and North Shore coverage
- [Wisconsin News](https://www.duluthnewstribune.com/news/wisconsin): Wisconsin news and government updates from Apostle Islands region
- [National News](https://www.duluthnewstribune.com/news/national): National news, politics and breaking headlines from across US
- [World News](https://www.duluthnewstribune.com/news/world): International headlines and world news coverage daily
- [Forum News Network](https://www.duluthnewstribune.com/forum-news-network): Regional news broadcast network covering Minnesota, North/South Dakota
- [The Vault](https://www.duluthnewstribune.com/news/the-vault): True crime, historical mysteries and cold cases from Upper Midwest

## Sports

- [Sports News](https://www.duluthnewstribune.com/sports): Prep, college and professional sports news and game results
- [College Sports](https://www.duluthnewstribune.com/sports/college): UMD Bulldogs and college sports news from Minnesota schools
- [Bulldog Insider](https://www.duluthnewstribune.com/sports/bulldogs-hockey/bulldoginsider): University of Minnesota Duluth hockey program coverage and recruiting
- [Prep Sports](https://www.duluthnewstribune.com/sports/prep): High school sports coverage from Minnesota and Wisconsin region
- [Pro Sports](https://www.duluthnewstribune.com/sports/pro): Professional sports coverage of Minnesota teams and NFL/NBA/NHL/MLB
- [Northland Outdoors](https://www.duluthnewstribune.com/sports/northland-outdoors): Hunting, fishing and outdoor recreation news from Great Lakes region

## Weather & Community

- [Weather](https://www.duluthnewstribune.com/weather): Duluth weather forecasts, radar and StormTracker coverage
- [Obituaries](https://www.duluthnewstribune.com/obituaries): Death notices and obituaries from Duluth and surrounding areas
- [Health & Wellness](https://www.duluthnewstribune.com/health): Healthcare, medical and wellness news from Mayo Clinic and regional providers
